lines.text: You must be the engineer from the FCC. Rosa Delgado, master control. Come in, mind the cables.
I'll save you some trouble: I'm the one who wrote to you. Please don't say so in front of Mr. Brandt.
Your letter mentioned a second picture on Channel 7. Programs you never aired.
Every Tuesday night since September. The viewers call me, and I keep a log. It's all in here.

choices.text: Tell me about the ghost picture.

lines.text: It hides right under our own carrier. Same frequency, but phase-inverted - like a photographic negative.
Our picture swamps it. Null ours out on the analyzer and it's there. And it rolls - bring the H-hold way down.
The analyzer is on the bench by the far wall. Get a clean lock and patch it through to the house monitors.

choices.text: Can I record what's on it?

lines.text: The deck on the bench records off the monitor bus. Thread a reel, switch on a set nearby, press REC.
Blank stock is on the shelves in the tape library, across the corridor. Nobody counts it but me.
Here - two reels. Don't tell Brandt how much we go through.
Any luck on the analyzer? Same frequency as ours. Null the phase. Slow the roll.

choices.text: Remind me how to record it.
Could I have more blank tape?

lines.text: There it is. Channel 7-B, you're calling it? Look at it. That's Dot. That's our set.
And it's in color. We don't own a color camera. They're delivered tomorrow.

choices.text: What's on the schedule this week?
Could I have more blank tape?

lines.text: The program log is in the cabinet by the case board - master control copy. Thursday is the big Futura day.
Thursday's show, on a Tuesday night. You know what you're telling me?
Then I'll say the other part. If the ghost is us - Thursday us - then whatever it shows is coming.

choices.text: Could I have more blank tape?

lines.text: Two hundred kilowatts. It has to be Mr. Penrose. Nobody else touches the Skyhook.
Tuesdays he sends me home early and stays in the hall. Then the calls start.
There's something else. I found this reel in the erase bin last week. His initials. It sounds like nonsense.
Forwards it's gibberish. But he's an old radio ham - they do tricks with tape. Try every button on the deck.
Did the reel make sense? Engineers think backwards sometimes.

choices.text: Could I have more blank tape?

lines.text: Thursday night. A bulletin. Dot, and then a fire, and then nothing at all.
Talk to Mr. Penrose. Make him stop. He'll listen to the law if he won't listen to me.

choices.text: Could I have more blank tape?

lines.text: 7-B's gone. Nothing but carrier hum. I keep looking at it anyway.
I'll put in a good word for you with the Commission. Off the record, of course.
